title: SafetyNet
description: Give individual players mob protection, keep inventory on death, and instant respawn with simple commands.
body:
## Safetynet

I play on a **hardcore** world with friends. One of us dies more often than the rest, and we still wanted to keep hardcore on for everyone without turning the whole world into normal survival or making revives obvious.

**Safetynet** is a small server mod that lets you turn on extra help **for one player or multiple**. The world stays hardcore. **(or Normal you don't need to have a Hardcore World)** Other players are unchanged. You don’t need to install anything on other people’s games only the server (or your singleplayer world) needs the mod.

---

### What it does

| Feature | What players notice |
|--------|----------------------|
| **Mob ignore** | Mobs stop attacking that player. |
| **Keep inventory** | They keep their items when they die. |
| **Immediate respawn** | No death screen they come back right away. In hardcore they **respawn normally** instead of becoming a spectator. |
| **“Woke up” messages** | With immediate respawn on, chat says things like *“Alex woke up from being blown up by a Creeper”* instead of a normal death message so it feels like they passed out and woke up, not that they “died” for good. |

Every option is a **toggle**: run the same command again to turn it **off** for that player.

Settings **save** across logout and death.

---

### Commands

You need **operator / cheats**.

Replace **PlayerNames** with the real Minecraft name of the player (no `<` or `>` in the game).

**Mob ignores**
`/safetynet ignore <PlayerName>`

**Keep inventorys**
`/safetynet keepinventory <PlayerName>`

**Immediate respawns**
`/safetynet immediaterespawn <PlayerName>`

**Example:** if the player is called Alex, you type:
`/safetynet ignore Alex`

**Turn off again** run the same command again with the same name:
`/safetynet immediaterespawn Alex`
